3951-4247-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4247-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
107-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3259-4885-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2301-2946-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2946-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2511-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1123-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
1123-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Flayer of the Hatebound.
Flayer of the Hatebound dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Flayer of the Hatebound, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

2438-5075-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-5075-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

413-628-7219.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Reaper trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

1339-2921-6713.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2558-3490-5226-5231-6701.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-5226-5231-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

1296-3765--103.description:
Cast Finale of Promise by paying {9}{R}{R}, casting the instant that deals damage or causes lifeloss and Worldfire from your graveyard without paying their mana costs.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the instant that deals damage or causes lifeloss, causing each opponent to lose at least 1 life or be dealt at least 1 damage.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1445-2292-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-4477-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4477-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
719-2102-3814.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

101-1987-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
101-1987-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

751-971-5684.description:

When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Metastatic Evangel trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, putting a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

Silverskin Armor attached to Kitsa.

Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Mastermind's Acquisition by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mastermind's Acquisition and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
